data.name: Code of War Gun Shooting Games
data.detailed_description:
⚔️ WELCOME TO SHOOTING GAMES ⚔️

Step into the ultimate shooter experience where modern battles never stop! Code of War is a multiplayer shooter packed with fast-paced action, tactical choices, and non-stop excitement. Whether you love intense pvp shooter duels, large-scale battlefield chaos, classic fps games, or competitive gun games, this is your mission.

🔥 WHY YOU’LL LOVE COOL GAMES 🔥
✅ Thrilling first person shooter and third-person shooting mechanics;
✅ Multiple modes – from 5v5 combat to solo standoff challenges and quick free fire skirmishes;
✅ Realistic guns – sniper rifles, assault weapons, grenades & more;
✅ Smooth controls;
✅ Join millions of players in epic online multiplayer war games.

🎮 GAME MODES 🎮
• Team Deathmatch – Squad up in intense pvp battles, strike first, and dominate;
• Solo Deathmatch – No backup, no mercy. Just you and your gun simulator against all;
• Special Forces Missions – Tactical shooter games with high-risk objectives;
• Tournaments & Leaderboards – Rise through ranks, prove you’re among the true legends of modern combat.

🔫 ARSENAL OF MODERN WARFARE 🔫
Choose from dozens of powerful guns and gear. Unlock deadly sniper rifles, shotguns, assault weapons, and explosives. Whether you prefer a tactical strike from afar or close-range shooting games action, you’ll find your perfect gun game loadout. Every firefight feels like real SWAT modern combat.

🌍 VARIETY OF MAPS & ARENAS 🌍
Engage in warfare across diverse environments:
🏙️ Urban streets filled with nonstop fire;
🌲 Open fields for long-range sniper duels;
🏭 Industrial zones for strategic tactical shooter moves;
🏰 Competitive arena battle where every second counts.

⚡ KEY FEATURES ⚡
• Free-to-play online fps packed with nonstop action;
• Smooth pvp shooter gameplay;
• Join global multiplayer games with players from around the world;
• Dynamic army games atmosphere – feel like a real soldier in the military;
• Play like elite special forces in the most intense top war shooting game;
• Become part of epic modern war history.

💥 JOIN THE FIGHT 💥
Will you shoot your way to victory with fast reflexes, or rely on smart tactical teamwork? This is not just another shooter game—this is your chance to become a legend of critical battles.

Download now and prove you’re the best in shooter online fun games. This is where legends are forged in the universe of army games and multiplayer. Whether you love tactical shooter depth or arcade-speed popular gun games, Code of War stands tall among multiplayer shooter titles.

data.short_description: Military shooting games, online shooter and awesome online war games! This is a free-to-play multiplayer third-person action game in a modern warfare setting. Take part in intense 8-player battles in Deathmatch and Team Deathmatch modes. Choose from a rich arsenal of weapons, upgrade your soldier!
data.supported_languages:
English*, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Portuguese - Brazil, Vietnamese, Simplified Chinese, Korean, Russian*, Japanese
*languages with full audio support

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel® Core™2 Quad Q6600 & AMD Athlon II X4 640 AM3
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 660 or AMD Radeon RX 460 or Intel HD 630 (2GB VRAM)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 3 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Mac OS X 10.9 (Mavericks)
  • Processor: Quad core CPU 3.3 GHz
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD 630 or similar (2GB VRAM)
  • Storage: 2 GB available space

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Steam OS, Linux Ubuntu 12.04
  • Processor: Quad core CPU 3.3 GHz
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD 630 or similar (2GB VRAM)
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Additional Notes: recent binary ATI or NVidia drivers (MESA may not work reliably)
